surface.$description: The screen ground of the Figma file.

surface-raised.$description: Cards, sheets and inputs raised above the screen ground.

surface-hover.$description: A control on the ground or on ivory under the pointer: the brand blue's tint (R10).

surface-pressed.$description: A control on the ground or on ivory while it is pressed (R10). A pressed state only: a selected item is designed with accent.

surface-raised-hover.$description: A control on a raised surface under the pointer (R10): one step deeper than on the ground, which white needs to show.

surface-raised-pressed.$description: A control on a raised surface while it is pressed (R10).

on-surface.$description: Text and numbers are blue, as in the Figma file.

on-surface-muted.$description: Secondary text, hints and captions on the surfaces.

brand.$description: The logo, the app icon and decorative areas.

primary.$description: The brand orange on filled controls, bars and orange text; under the owner's contrast exception (architecture §9.5 R4).

primary-hover.$description: A primary control under the pointer: a deeper step of the brand orange (R10).

primary-pressed.$description: A primary control while it is pressed (R10).

on-primary.$description: Ivory labels on orange, as in the Figma file.

heading.$description: Titles and section headings, in bold; under the owner's contrast exception.

accent.$description: The brand blue on filled secondary controls and selected states.

border.$description: Decorative dividers and card outlines only; a control boundary uses border-strong.

border-strong.$description: Control boundaries at 3:1: inputs, checkboxes, outlined buttons.

border-hover.$description: A control boundary under the pointer: the outline turns full blue (R10).

border-pressed.$description: A control boundary or an off track pressed: a deeper blue beyond the hover (R10).

focus-ring.$description: The keyboard focus ring, at 3:1 on every surface.

success.$description: Delivered, paid, accepted: success text, icons and fills.

warning.$description: Delays and states that need attention soon.

danger-hover.$description: A danger control under the pointer (R10).

danger-pressed.$description: A danger control while it is pressed (R10).

alert.$description: Alerts read from across a room: 7:1.

on-alert.$description: Labels and icons on alert, at 7:1.

disabled.$description: The fill of a disabled control.

on-disabled.$description: The label of a disabled control.

chart.$description: Categorical chart colours, in this order.
